title: Bombay HC: A Foreign Seat Does Not Oust Section 9 Interim Relief
case_name: Malaney Trading Co. Pvt. Ltd. v. Uzer Makina
citation: 2026 SCC OnLine Bom 5045; Commercial Arbitration Petition No. 228 of 2022, decided 7 July 2026
card_summary: Justice Somasekhar Sundaresan held that an arbitration seated with the Netherlands Arbitration Institute, whose rules provide for emergency relief, does not take away a party's right to seek interim protection under Section 9. Malaney Trading held a partial NAI award against Uzer Makina. The court directed Uzer Makina to secure the rupee equivalent of EUR 1.2 million pending final quantification.
card_tip: Picking institutional rules with an emergency-arbitrator mechanism does not on its own exclude Section 9; still plead why interim protection from an Indian court is needed.
verification_notes: Date (7 July 2026), bench (Justice Somasekhar Sundaresan), docket (Commercial Arbitration Petition No. 228 of 2022), citation (2026 SCC OnLine Bom 5045), the 2017 agency agreement background, the NAI partial award of 16 February 2024, and the EUR 1.2 million security direction are consistent across Nishith Desai Associates' hotline, LiveLawBiz and Rawlaw.
